title: Introduce plugin packaging + local consumption guide for compact RAG plugins
author: Priya Nair
description: Adds a compact, opinionated guide and example to package RAG plugins for local consumption and offline testing. Motivation: teams keep asking for a repeatable way to bundle tool adapters (HTTP webhook stubs, binary helpers, small indexers) so they can transfer shareable plugin artifacts across environments (CI, staging, air-gapped). This PR provides a spec (plugin.json manifest), a simple CLI packing/verify flow, a tiny Node + Python shim example, and a local 'rwg serve-plugin' dev server that mirrors Redwood Private's plugin loader semantics. The guide focuses on reproducibility, signature verification, and small-surface dev ergonomics rather than production distribution mechanics. What changed: 1) docs: new quickstart guide at quickstarts/plugin-packaging/README.md with step-by-step packaging, consumption, and security notes; 2) examples: sample plugin in quickstarts/plugin-packaging/example-plugin/ (node adapter + manifest + tests); 3) tooling: lightweight packaging helper script quickstarts/plugin-packaging/bin/rwg-pack (POSIX Python script) and verify helper bin/rwg-verify; 4) devserver: example dev server script quickstarts/plugin-packaging/bin/rwg-serve-plugin to allow local mounts and HTTP toolbridge simulation; 5) CI: added smoke e2e job for the quickstart to the quickstarts workflow. Backwards compatibility: no runtime changes to core Redwood; the artifacts are strictly examples and dev tools. Security: recommends signature verification and KMS-backed signing for production artifacts. See linked Linear items for product context. Checklist: - [x] guide draft - [x] example plugin - [x] packaging + verify scripts - [x] CI smoke - [x] reviewers addressed comments
commits_summary: 4 commits: initial guide and manifest scaffold; add node adapter example and basic tests; add rwg-pack and rwg-verify scripts with usage docs; add rwg-serve-plugin devserver and CI smoke job. Each commit includes small readme and test modifications only.
